**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king moves to an undefended square (especially without castling), look for aggressive queen checks that disrupt their coordination. Here, Qe3+ forces the king away while your pieces control key escape squares. Combining a check with threats to multiple pieces (the rook and bishop) often wins material by force—a pattern worth drilling.
